name: Five-Star Business Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Five Star Business Finance Limited is an NBFC-ND-SI providing secured business loans to micro-entrepreneurs and self-employed individuals across South India.[1]
keyPoints: Leading NBFC in South India[1] Five-Star Business Finance is one of the fastest growing (20.5% CAGR between FY20 -FY24)[2] NBFC-ND-SI providing secured business loans to microentrepreneurs and self-employed individuals.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 32.6% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -2.90%
